>The issue is that `handle_payment_webhook` in `service/payment_service.py` is not idempotent under concurrency. 

When two requests with the same `webhook_id` arrive simultaneously:
1. Both might pass any check (though there isn't one currently).
2. Both will call `payment_repo.upsert(pay)`. Since `pay["id"]` is a new `uuid4()`, it creates two different payment records even if they have the same `webhook_id`.
3. Both will call `invoice_service.mark_paid(invoice_id)`.
4. Both will call `entitlement_service.activate_paid_plan(...)`.
5. Both will call `outbox.insert(...)`.

To fix this, we should use the `webhook_id` to ensure idempotency.
